messages:
Ivy (Product): Hi team — first day here! Quick checklist so I don't miss anything: 1) Figma access path? 2) where's the canonical roadmap and component inventory? 3) how do we start a research brief (templates, handoff)? cc @Luis :wave:

Luis (Design Lead): Welcome Ivy 389 For Figma we use SSO via Okta. Steps: Okta -> Apps -> Request 'Figma (Redwood)'. If it shows pending beyond 30min DM Maya. I'll also send a manual invite to the Product team and the 'Component Inventory' file.

Maya (Design Ops): Hi Ivy 44b Auto-approve runs during biz hours; contractors sometimes need manual checks. If you hit pending DM me the Okta request id and I'll force-invite. Also added a 1-page "Design onboarding checklist" to your email with links to: Product UI Kit, Component Inventory, Research Playbooks, and Design Crit calendar.

Ben (PM): Roadmap: Confluence -> /product/strategy/roadmap. We keep a live kanban of initiatives and link to the initiative docs which include metrics and open tasks. For component inventory we keep a single canonical Figma file + a Confluence index (shortlink in the onboarding checklist).

Ivy (Product): thanks — for research briefs do we prefer a full spec or a lightweight note to kick things off? also what's the usual recruiting flow (internal panel vs vendor)?

Luis (Design Lead): We ask for a short brief to start (1-paragraph problem, 2-3 questions, target users, 1 success metric). Templates live in Drive -> design/research/playbooks. Handoff: PM posts brief to #design-research with tag "study-request", Design Ops (Maya) triages and chooses recruitment channel. For quick tests we use internal panel; for larger studies we use UserTesting/Recruiter.

Maya (Design Ops): Adding process notes: if you need a moderated study, include preferred dates and ~10 screener criteria in the brief. We usually aim to recruit within 5 business days for external panels. For same-day hallway tests, share a Figma prototype and add results to the playbook. We keep the screening & consent templates in the playbook folder.

Access Bot: Access request received: 'Figma' submitted by Ivy. Ticket #ACC-11007. Est. approval window: 1-3 hours.

Ivy (Product): I submitted via Okta and it's pending. Maya I'll DM the ticket now. Also would love a 20-min "how research works here" quick sync later this week.

Luis (Design Lead): Happy to run a 20-min sync. Can do Thursday 10:30am PT. We'll cover how we prioritize studies, where briefs live, and the critique cadence.

Maya (Design Ops): Manual approve completed, sent Figma invite and added you to Component Inventory + Research Playbooks. Pinned the quick "first-week tasks" in the playbook (read: roadmap overview, last quarter's research synth, component ownership matrix).

Ivy (Product): Got the Figma invite and Drive access 60a Thanks all! See you Thursday 10:30am for the research sync.
